configuration.purpose: Full 89-task HIGH, one-attempt study. Preserve compatible six-task pilot cells and extend to all tasks after official environment controls.

definitions.cost_denominator: All ended attempts for these 18 tasks, including setup/transport failures; per-cell averages divide by 36.
definitions.tokens: Input includes cached input; output includes reasoning. Partial/unknown usage remains labeled.
definitions.selection: Six fixed pilot tasks plus the first twelve completed expansion tasks, stopping before dna-assembly; not a random or full-benchmark sample.

request_failure_sensitivity.reason: Exclude both tasks containing request-failure regrades for every group and both networks, preserving matched task sets.

source_configuration_note: Configuration is inherited from the historical expansion plan. This report covers only the completed 18-task subset in both network modes; actual transport and policy generations are recorded in runtime_cohorts.
